title: Limits of retrospective robot-task duration calibration and causal dispatch inference in open collective robotic construction logs
description: Secondary, exploratory audit of public Stuttgart collective robotic construction logs (Skoury and Leder, DaRUS DOI 10.18419/DARUS-5612): 12 runs, 22571 events, 9314 Move/Grip robot commands. A refitted fixed-residual calibration had 3.491630 s MAE on 3237 retrospective test commands versus 3.449721 s for the global-median baseline, while a recent-observation adaptive estimator scored 3.365057 s. Critically, the logs do not identify the causal effect of alternative dispatch policies; no field deployment or improvement in physical operations is claimed.
